items.headline: LA 2028 marathon qualifying marks set at 2:05:00 and 2:22:20
items.summary: World Athletics published the LA28 qualification system, with marathon standards about a minute faster than for Beijing 2027 and 70 places per race. The qualifying window runs from 1 November 2026 to 30 April 2028, and the first five at Platinum Label marathons count as having met the standard.

items.headline: Joshua Griffiths gets three-month ban for cocaine metabolite
items.summary: The Athletics Integrity Unit announced a three-month suspension for the British marathoner after a sample at the Belfast marathon in May contained a cocaine metabolite. His fourth place there was disqualified, and the ban had already run its course by September.

items.headline: Beijing 2027 World Championships marathon dates set
items.summary: The women's marathon at the 2027 World Championships in Beijing is scheduled for 12 September and the men's for 19 September, both starting at 7:30 local time.

items.headline: Sato wins Kobe Marathon; Chelangat wins on debut
items.summary: Satoshi Sato of Japan won the men's Kobe Marathon in 2:09:46, eight seconds ahead of Barnaba Kipkoech. Uganda's Annet Chelangat took the women's race in 2:28:09 on her marathon debut.
